partners.title: Partners
partners.emptyBody: Partners appear once there are contracts.
partners.foot: Scores are recalculated each time the page opens, from payments, deliveries, reminders, kept appointments, prices and manual ratings over the last {{months}} months.
partners.noCriteria1: No manually rated criteria for {{role}} yet. Add one in
partners.noCriteria2: (e.g. “Product quality”), then come back to rate 0–100.
partners.expired: · outside the scoring window, no longer counted

scoring.title: Reputation scoring
scoring.lead: Only managers can edit. Every change is kept in the history.
scoring.manualHint: Manual: each partner is rated 0–100 on the partners page

hint.payment_on_time: % of instalments paid on time, minus days late
hint.cks_renewal: Renews before expiry, and renews with us
hint.reminders: Payment and obligation reminders per contract
hint.appointments: % of appointments not moved or cancelled
hint.complaints: Number of complaints, points off each time
hint.price: Current price against the cheapest offer for the same product (contracts, quotes)

scoring.removeManual: Ratings already given stay in the history but no longer count. Applies only after Save.
scoring.removeAuto: It can be restored from the list of built-in criteria. Applies only after Save.
scoring.manualNote2: : people rate each partner 0–100 on Partners › “Rate” or via the assistant. Partners not yet rated skip this criterion and the others share its weight.
scoring.when1: Scores are not stored: every time you open the partner list or a score, it is computed with the saved rules.
scoring.when2: Data comes from what the app records as you work: Received / Paid (on time or late), postponements, reminders, signature renewals or losses, complaints / deliveries / appointments; from contracts (tenure, current prices) and manual ratings.
scoring.when3d: ) or at the bottom of a contract, or tell the assistant. Logged by mistake? Press “Void” on that line.
scoring.when4: “Save & rescore” also snapshots every partner's score for the change history.

goods.emptyBody: Add a quote, or save a purchase contract, to compare prices.

errors.VALIDATION_ERROR: Check the quote (unit price must be a whole number above 0)
errors.NOT_FOUND: This product can no longer be compared
errors.PACK_FORBIDDEN: You are not allowed to add quotes
